base-100.$description: ---- Surfaces -------------------------------------------------------- */ /* base-100: page background. NHS White #FFFFFF — the default canvas */ /* used behind body copy and primary content areas.

base-200.$description: base-200: secondary surface. NHS Pale Grey #E8EDEE — sectioned */ /* backgrounds, sidebars, and the "grey-panel" pattern in the manual.

base-300.$description: base-300: tertiary surface. Slightly darker pale grey used for */ /* dividers, table zebra-striping and hover backgrounds on list rows.

base-content.$description: base-content: primary text. NHS Black #212B32 — the body- copy */ /* colour. Note this is NOT pure black; it warms text slightly to */ /* reduce on-screen glare per NHS readability guidance.

primary.$description: ---- Primary (NHS Blue) --------------------------------------------- */ /* Primary action colour. NHS Blue #005EB8 — the signature brand */ /* colour used on the NHS logo block, primary buttons, and active nav.

secondary.$description: ---- Secondary (NHS Dark Blue) -------------------------------------- */ /* Hover / pressed state for primary, and secondary chrome. */ /* NHS Dark Blue #003087 — also used for visited links by some teams.

accent.$description: ---- Accent (NHS Light Blue) ---------------------------------------- */ /* Illustrative accent. NHS Light Blue #41B6E6 — used in charts, */ /* diagrams, and supplementary UI cues. Not for primary CTAs. Darkened from L=0.67 on 2026-08-27: white accent-content needs >=4.5:1 for small text (axe color-contrast on ai- label).

neutral.$description: ---- Neutral -------------------------------------------------------- */ /* Neutral chrome (footer, dark cards). Mirrors base- content so that */ /* the page maintains a single neutral identity across both polarities.

info.$description: ---- Info (NHS Bright Blue) ----------------------------------------- */ /* Informational banners, links, and "did you know?" callouts. */ /* NHS Bright Blue #0072CE — distinct from primary so banners read as */ /* messages rather than calls to action.

success.$description: ---- Success (NHS Green) -------------------------------------------- */ /* Confirmation, completed-step, "you have been booked" panels. */ /* NHS.UK frontend green #007F3B, nhsuk-frontend 10.7.1 `$nhsuk-success-colour` (core/settings/_colours- applied.scss, new in v10). Re-baselined 2026-10-29 from NHS Identity green #009639, which gave white content 4.37:1 (below AA); white content is now 5.19:1.

warning.$description: ---- Warning (NHS Warm Yellow) -------------------------------------- */ /* Caution banners and the canonical focus indicator. */ /* NHS Warm Yellow #FFB81C — because the swatch is light, content */ /* must be dark (≈ NHS Black) to clear WCAG AA contrast.

error.$description: ---- Error (NHS Emergency Services Red) ----------------------------- */ /* Validation errors, destructive actions, urgent banners. */ /* NHS Emergency Services Red #DA291C — reserved for genuine errors; */ /* do not use for decorative emphasis (it carries strong NHS meaning).

selector.$description: ---- Geometry tokens (clinical / high-density) --------------------- */ /* Selectors (checkbox / radio): square per NHS frontend defaults. Doubly appropriate for clinical UI where checklist grids dominate (allergies, observations, problem-list flags, drug interactions).

field.$description: Form fields: 2px corners — sharper than the 4px patient theme. Clinical instruments traditionally use crisp rectangles; the small radius keeps a hint of softness so the UI doesn't read as hostile.

box.$description: Card / panel / dialog: 2px corner radius. Tight corners keep clinical worklists, observation tables, and side-panel cards visually instrument-like and align edges to a 2px grid.

selector.$description: Inner padding hints for selectors and fields — compressed so checklist rows and field grids pack tightly.

border.$description: Border width: 1px hairline, Lily's own hairline, not an upstream value: nhsuk-frontend 10 has no `$nhsuk-border- width-form`; its form controls use `$nhsuk-border-width- form-element` (2px). The hairline is the smallest legible border on the LCDs used in clinical settings; going to 0.5px loses the edge on non-Retina workstation displays still common in NHS estate.

depth.$description: Depth & noise off — NHS guidance avoids shadows and textures so */ /* the interface looks clinical, calm, and easy to read.

fluid-gutter.$description: Fluid inline gutter for page containers and the main region: grows with the viewport from a 1rem floor to a 2rem ceiling. Spacing only, never text.

fluid-section.$description: Fluid gap between sections (stacks and grids): grows with the viewport from a 1rem floor to a 2rem ceiling. Spacing only, never text.
